questions.question: What is a province? Name the biggest province and the smallest province.
questions.expected_answer: A province is one of the parts that a country is divided into so that it is easier to govern. Each has its own government and capital city. The biggest province by area is the Northern Cape, and the smallest is Gauteng.

questions.question: Name the four coastal provinces and the five inland provinces.
questions.expected_answer: Coastal: Northern Cape, Western Cape, Eastern Cape and KwaZulu-Natal. Inland: Free State, North West, Gauteng, Limpopo and Mpumalanga.

questions.question: Name any five provinces with their capital cities.
questions.expected_answer: Any five of: Northern Cape, Kimberley; Western Cape, Cape Town; Eastern Cape, Bhisho; KwaZulu-Natal, Pietermaritzburg; Free State, Bloemfontein; North West, Mahikeng; Gauteng, Johannesburg; Limpopo, Polokwane; Mpumalanga, Mbombela.
